messages:
jenny: Heads up — noticed an RBAC regression after yesterday's permissions refactor. Admins with the 'billing-admin' role can enumerate usage for unrelated customers. Putting this in triage.

omar: Ugh. Any logs or repro?

jenny: Repro is simple: call GET /admin/usage?org_id=<our-tenant-id> as a billing-admin, then omit org_id and the API returns a list containing other orgs. Seen in prod from 2026-03-12T08:12:03Z in the access logs.

kevin: Can you paste the policy snippet that changed?

jenny: Policy diff shows we introduced a wildcard match on project scope. Snippet:

```
- resource: "project:{project_id}:billing:usage"
+ resource: "project:*:billing:usage"
  action: ["read"]
  principal: ["role:billing-admin"]
```

jenny: That `project:*` is the likely culprit — intended to allow cross-project admins for infra but ended up granting cross-tenant cost view.

lina: Confirming from KMS/audit: the service account used by the billing service has Decrypt on the global usage key. Audit entries show decrypts for keys tied to multiple tenant blobs by the billing svc-account between 08:10–08:15 UTC.

kevin: Ok mitigation plan: 1) revert the policy change (remove `project:*`) 2) rotate the billing service key scope (restrict to project-level keys) 3) add runtime guard in gateway to require matching org header for billing endpoints. Anyone object?

jenny: +1 on all. Also add a short-term ACL in front of /admin/usage to return 403 unless header X-Request-Org matches token org claim.

omar: I'll open a hotfix PR for gateway ACL. ETA 45m.

lina: I'll scope the KMS key policies and raise key rotation request.

kevin: I'll revert the policy in the IAM registry and push a small migration to remove the wildcard.

audit-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0312-RBAC-USAGE-01. Severity: medium (cost/usage exposure). Notifying compliance.

jenny: Can we capture all principals that queried usage in the window? I can run a query against access logs but want to be sure we capture any exported copies — check object storage audit as well.

lina: On it. Found two internal tool tokens used by "billing-aggregator" and one by an SRE runbook job. Pulling object-store access logs now.

omar: Hotfix PR up: link https://git.internal/r/redwood/gateway/pulls/812 — adds the in-gateway org header check and a feature flag to turn off billing-admin cross-project. Deploying to canary.

kevin: After canary, push to prod and rotate keys. Also note we should add an e2e test to catch wildcard resource patterns in future policy reviews.

jenny: Filing follow-ups: postmortem, telemetry alert for unexpected `project:*` policies, and a compliance notification to customers affected.

kevin: Nice triage. Keep updates in this thread and ping #incidents when we've got keys rotated. :lock:
